transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Honestly, Doctor, I feel absolutely amazing and just bursting with this incredible, overflowing energy! For the last ten months, I've barely needed to sleep at all because I'm constantly on the go and doing a million things at once. I just feel completely unstoppable, though I do get really easily irritated when people try to slow me down!

During these periods of high energy, have you ever experienced a break from reality, such as hearing or seeing things that others didn't, or have you had to be hospitalized because your behavior was severely disruptive or dangerous?

Yes, I've definitely seen and heard things that others couldn't, and had some really intense, unusual beliefs, but it only ever happens during these high-energy phases when I'm not sleeping. I've never actually been hospitalized for it, but those breaks from reality definitely occur during these intense times.
